shields_note: Posted 'Defensive Shields (10)' outside the 60; all ten are named.
notes: Posted 9 December 2001, before Theed Palace (12 December 2001), so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Starting cards as posted (marked 'starting'): Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Epic Duel, Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Prepared Defenses, Fear Is My Ally, Visage Of The Emperor, You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points, Crush The Rebellion, Colo Claw Fish; these count toward the 60.
Imperial Decree is posted as 'starting if opponent is playing EBO and replaces YCHF&MP'; it is counted in the 60.
The Effects heading says 9, but 10 effects are listed (Visage Of The Emperor x2 included); with them the deck totals 60.
Posted 'It Could be worse' is kept as written: It Could Be Worse is a Light Side card, and the Dark counterpart It's Worse is already in the listed Ommni Box & It's Worse combo.

Posted 'HDADTJ' dested Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi; 'Executor Meditation Chamber' dested the printed Dagobah site; 'Endor Back Door' dested the Dark Endor site; 'Naboo Theed Palace Generator' and 'Generator Core' dested the Dark Reflections III sites; 'Colo Claw Fish' dested the Dark Reflections III effect; 'U-3P0' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).
Posted 'Darth Maul's Double Bladed Lightsaber' dested Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber; 'Aura Sing' dested Aurra Sing; 'Chimeara' dested Chimaera.
The ten Defensive Shields are the Reflections III Dark shields; where a Dark card of the same name exists, the shield page is used (e.g. Allegations Of Corruption (Dark), Battle Order (Dark)).
